description: Get copy-paste code to show a scene inside a web page. Use it when the user wants the scene on their website, store or CMS; for a link to send in a message, use create_share_link. Parameters: `aspect` sets the frame shape ('fill' takes the parent's size, for full-bleed heroes); `load` 'lazy' saves bandwidth below the fold, 'tap' suits pages with many scenes, 'eager' suits a single hero; `background` is hex without #, 'transparent' to sit on the page colour, or 'studio:warm'; `share_token` is required for a private scene and is the token inside the link create_share_link returned. Read-only and makes no change to the scene; works without sign-in for public and unlisted scenes.

load.description: 'lazy' (default) loads when scrolled into view, 'tap' only on tap, 'eager' immediately.

scene.description: Scene id (e.g. palm-villa-0a1b2c3d4e5f), the job id returned by upload_scene, or a Verse share link.

share_token.description: Share token of a private scene.

name: get_embed_code

iframe.description: Iframe HTML that works in any site builder.

script.description: Script tag that loads the <verse-viewer> component.
